name: theme-heisei-retro
docs: FONTS (required): add to your HTML <head> — CSS @import breaks Vite/lightningcss. <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Zen+Kaku+Gothic+New:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">. Then wrap your app root in class="theme-heisei-retro" (add sf-enforce if the app bakes font/shadow literals).
title: Heisei Retro
description: Heisei Retro — 90s Japanese tech catalog: warm beige plastic, red/blue, dense boxes — fonts via <link> (see docs), full app-variable bridge (shadcn + sidebar + charts + font/shadow scales). Wrap your app root in class "theme-heisei-retro".
